definitions.explanation: A person who supports, encourages, or cheers for someone or something.

examples.japanese: {応援者|おうえんしゃ}が{大勢|おおぜい}{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: A large number of supporters gathered.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{多|おお}くの{応援者|おうえんしゃ}に{支|ささ}えられている。
examples.english: He is supported by many backers.

examples.japanese: マラソンの{沿道|えんどう}には{熱心|ねっしん}な{応援者|おうえんしゃ}たちが{声援|せいえん}を{送|おく}っていた。
examples.english: Along the marathon route, enthusiastic supporters were sending cheers.

notes:
Formed from {応援|おうえん} (support/cheering) and the suffix {者|しゃ} (person). This word covers both informal supporters and organized cheerleaders.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱心|ねっしん}な{応援者|おうえんしゃ}: enthusiastic supporter
- {応援者|おうえんしゃ}を{募|つの}る: to recruit supporters
- {応援者|おうえんしゃ}の{声援|せいえん}: cheers from supporters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {支持者|しじしゃ}: supporter (more political; someone who endorses a position or candidate)
- ファン: fan (borrowed from English; focuses on admiration)
- サポーター: supporter (loanword; often used in sports contexts)
- {応援団|おうえんだん}: cheering squad (organized group, not an individual)
